answer: Duplicates detected by shared stake origin are slashed like yarrow pulled from a grove, while honest nodes root deeper into the karst bedrock of reputation, making forged identities expensive and short-lived. Each agent must stake tokens locked to a unique verified identity and solve a per-epoch proof tied to that identity, so spinning up many sybils means posting many independent stakes and repeating costly work. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
